lines.t: As in the Days of Noah
Hammer on the timbers in the dust‑choked dawn
Mockers at the hillside, laughing as they yawn
One man builds a lifeboat where no sea is found
Faith against a sky of brass and cracking ground
Children in the doorway, counting every beam
Pitch upon the wooden ribs, black and gleam
Animals are gathering from valley, field, and hill
Drawn by unseen whisper, by the Sovereign will
They say, “Where is the rain you speak?
Where is the storm you fear?”
But the earth beneath their feet grows weak
The tremor drawing near
As in the days of Noah, so it shall be again
Ark lifted from the valley while the waters cover men
One Door in the side, one Refuge from the wave
YahuShua is the Ark, the only Shelter that can save
While judgment falls like oceans, and fountains break below
The Ark ascends to Heaven, and the world is swallowed whole
Clouds bruise black on the horizon rim
Lightning crowns the mountains, daylight growing dim
Deep beneath the furrows, ancient fault lines strain
Springs of the abyss awake in roaring pain
Water from the heavens, water from the ground
Sky and soil agreeing as they shake and pound
Doors of earth are breaking, cities start to sway
Foretaste of the quaking in the final Day
They pound upon the wooden wall
They claw the closing seam
Too late to change their drunken call
Too late to leave their dream
As in the days of Noah, so it shall be again
Ark lifted from the chaos while the flood consumes all men
One Door in the side, one Passage through the fire
YahuShua is the Ark, the only Stairway ever higher
While judgment falls like thunder, and mountains split below
The Ark ascends to Heaven, and the seas devour the glow
Now the hammer’s in the hand of every mortal soul
Plans spread out before them, warnings long foretold
Screens glow in the darkness, sirens in the street
Yet the greater shaking gathers underneath their feet
Voices on the housetops cry, “Peace is surely near”
Yet rumors roll like distant guns upon the watching ear
Clouds of war are forming, nations rage and roar
Still the only hope of shelter stands in One named Door
He calls across the tempest’s rise,
“Come in while there is light”
But lovers of the midnight skies
Turn deeper into night
As in the days of Noah, so it shall be once more
Ark ready for departure while they crowd the harbor shore
One Door in the side, one Narrow, bleeding Way
YahuShua is the Ark, the only Dawn beyond this Day
While judgment falls like storm‑winds, and world foundations break
The Ark will rise in glory, on the waves of one last quake
Whispers in the thunder: “Refuge in the Son”
Fire in the fault lines: “All their towers come undone”
Trumpets in the distance, louder every breath
Footsteps of the Lamb approaching valleys filled with death
Storm above the skyline, storm beneath the crust
Every self‑made kingdom turning back to dust
Yet hidden in the nail‑scarred wood, a remnant waits inside
Fastened to the Living Ark, carried on the rising tide
Close is the Door, close is the Door
Soon every scoffing tongue will rise no more
Shake earth, shake sky, shake every shore
Only those in YahuShua will endure that roar
As in the days of Noah, so it is tonight
Ark poised for lifting in the final flash of light
One Door, one Name, one Shelter from the storm
YahuShua is the Ark, the Everlasting Form
